goal: Allow command-line options to appear after non-option arguments across utilities
Prevent trailing options from being silently ignored or swallowed into positional arguments
Avoid misdirected RPC calls when passing options like wallet selectors after subcommands
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Approval without stated reasons after edge cases were addressed (w0xlt)
Earlier objections on tool compatibility and argument parsing were resolved (w0xlt, vicjuma)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it eliminates a footgun where trailing options like wallet selectors were silently ignored
It prevents misdirected RPC invocations while remaining reasonably deferrable

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes silent swallowing of trailing options across binary utilities
Standardizes GNU-style parsing and option termination to prevent configuration mistakes
